messages:
Emma (sales): Quick heads-up — Mediva wants to move to a 6-week POC but legal flagged compliance artifacts. They asked for: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted ok), ISO cert copy, a signed pen-test commitment letter, and a network/dataflow diagram showing VPC peering and KMS boundaries. Also they need a dedicated pricing ballpark for 3 reserved GPUs. Can @Sri (security) and @Michael (solutions) confirm what we can share and rough ETA?

Sri (security): We can share SOC2 Type II cover letter + redacted report. ISO cert copy is fine. For pen-test, we don’t hand out raw vuln scans publicly, but we provide a signed attestation/letter that a third-party pentest was completed and a summary of findings + remediation status. Need to confirm signature cadence with Legal for the customer-specific commitment.

Michael (solutions): I can produce the network/dataflow diagram — will need the POC topology. Are they testing hosted API or Dedicated? Also need expected QPS and model family (e.g., 7B/13B/70B) to size the 3-GPU quote correctly.

Emma (sales): They want Dedicated for predictable latency. Expecting ~20 concurrent requests, token lengths up to 1024, likely using a 13B model variant.

Michael (solutions): Ok — for 3 reserved A10G-ish GPUs that workload looks fine for bursty P95 SLOs. I’ll draft a diagram (VPC peering, subnet, NAT, KMS in customer account, private link). ETA: end of day tomorrow for draft.

Sri (security): For SOC2 redaction: we can redact org-specific client names and network IPs. The cover letter will state the report date and scope. For pen-test letter, Legal needs the exact recipient name and whether they require indemnities language. If they want a letter on our letterhead confirming an upcoming or completed test, Legal usually asks 3–5 business days to approve.

Rachel (legal): Confirming — we can sign a standard pen-test attestation letter that says: ‘Redwood had a third-party pentest on DATE, scope DESCRIPTION; no outstanding critical findings at time of issuance / or remediation plan attached.’ If customer requests custom warranty/indemnity text, that triggers escalation. For the standard letter turnaround I estimate 3 business days after Security sends the draft text. Also need to review any NDA that customer attaches to the artifact exchange.

Olivia (ops): I’ll prepare a secure one-time-access bundle in our private artifact share. Once artifacts are ready (SOC2 redacted PDF, ISO cert PDF, pen-test attestation PDF, network diagram PNG/PDF), I’ll upload and generate an expiring link (7 days). Please ping me when files are final.

Emma (sales): Thanks — timeline sanity check: Michael diagram by EOD tomorrow, Sri to prepare SOC2 redaction + draft pen-test wording by EOD next day, Rachel to review+approve letter within 3 business days after that, Olivia will upload and share link when ready. Is that everyone?

Sri (security): Yep. One more note on pen-test: we can include a short scope statement (external blackbox + internal creds optional). Need to confirm whether Mediva requires internal sensor logs — that is usually restricted.

Michael (solutions): For Dedicated pricing: rough monthly reserved quote for 3x A10G (or equiv) + network & support add-ons: $X/month. I’ll put together a line-item estimate (instance-only, managed support, setup/peering fee) and attach to the bundle.

Rachel (legal): Also request: if they ask for SOC2 Type II raw evidence (control testwork) we must refuse — provide only the report and attestation. Add that to the handoff notes so sales knows the limit.

Olivia (ops): Filing checklist for upload: 1) redacted SOC2 PDF, 2) ISO cert image, 3) pen-test attestation draft (marked DRAFT), 4) finalized network/dataflow diagram, 5) pricing XLS. I’ll name files with a short hash and date and hand a single link to the customer.

Emma (sales): Great — I’ll message Mediva with the plan and set expectation: delivery window ~5–7 business days (depends on Legal sign-off). @AttestBot can you create a stub record in the artifacts tracker when Olivia uploads?

AttestBot: Artifact upload webhook created. Will post tracking entry when files appear in /secure-artifacts/mediva-1769/ (access controlled).

Sri (security): For audit support question — if they ask for SOC2 auditor contact, we can provide the audit firm name and contact details only after confirming a valid NDA.

Emma (sales): Perfect. I’ll log this in the deal notes and move to confirm the NDA request. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Rachel (legal): If the customer requests a redline on the pen-test text, please loop me with their exact wording. Otherwise we’ll use standard language.

Michael (solutions): Draft diagram uploaded to my drive: https://redwood.internal/drawings/mediva-poc-diagram (will move to Olivia’s bundle when finalized).

Olivia (ops): Noted. Waiting on final artifacts from Sri and Michael. Will generate expiring link once ready.

Emma (sales): Closing loop — I’ve told Mediva to expect the expiring link and a standard pen-test attestation (no indemnities). They said they might push for raw vuln logs — we’ll decline per Legal. I’ll update if they push further.
